description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization ID generation, including encryption and decryption using AES-128-ECB with a specified salt, along with validation of the salt's presence.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a CryptoJS WordArray object for cryptographic processing.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates an organization ID by encrypting the normalized email using AES-128-ECB with a predefined salt, outputting a URL-encoded base64 string.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an organization ID back to email form, for debugging purposes, using the same AES configuration and salt.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the VALIDATED_TENANT_SALT is set and non-empty.
